observations_after_inspection: Buildings are grouped closely along a grid of streets in the lower left: a nucleated cluster within this frame.
The cluster lies beside the tarred main road, where the town street joins it; farther back, beyond the belt of trees, the main road crosses another road.
Open bush surrounds the cluster, with a smaller group of buildings further away.
The settlement continues past the left edge, so this is part of one place, not the pattern of a whole region.
